column11: Comments
This table must be sorted in the order of the ‘Code Point’ column.
Each code point in column ‘Code Point’ must be unique.
Only the first 3 columns A, B, C and also H are important for
generating the CSV file and should not be changed.
The other columns are only informational.
Column ‘Replacement code point’ determines the group to which the
glyph belongs. You can get a better idea of this by sorting the
table in the order of ‘Rank 1’.
To change the sorting order, add or remove a code point:
- sort the table in the order of the ‘Rank 2’ column
- change the order, insert or delete the glyph(s)
- renumber the ‘Rank 2’ column from 1 to n
- sort the table in the order of the ‘Point code’ column
When adding a glyph, it’s mandatory to:
duplicate the (yellow) formula in column B: ‘Rank 1’, and
also do the (yellow) formulae in F-G: ‘Glyph’ and I: ‘Replacement’.
Do not change the sheet name (sortingOrder)
